title: SMF Fatal Error v2.2.9 - Invalid Downlink Data Service Information
body:
Hi,

I'm getting this fatal error very frequently; it seems to occur when an UE tries to get connected again after a release. I just modified the AMF and the UPF to needed IPs and TAIs. The rest of configuration are the default ones; after this error, although the SMF restarts, I need to restart all NFs to get everything operative again. I dind't suffer it using the previous version. 

06/07 15:46:05.349: [smf] ERROR: Invalid Downlink Data Service Information (../src/smf/n4-handler.c:827)
